title: Admin Directory: Photo column shows clickable filenames with on-demand modal preview

requirements.summary: Preserve the Administrative Directory Table Photo column header cell label and structure exactly as-is while updating only the Photo column implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: The table header cell at the specified XPath displays the exact same label as before (no wording, casing, spacing, alignment, size, padding, or icon changes).
No other `<th>` elements in the table are changed.

file_operations.description: Locate the Administrative Directory Table header `<th>` that corresponds to the Photo column (the element matching XPath th[4]) and ensure its rendered user-facing label remains byte-for-byte identical to the current UI (e.g., still 'Photo'), with no structural/styling changes to that `<th>` or any other headers.

requirements.summary: Replace inline images in the Administrative Directory Table Photo column cells with a clickable filename that opens a modal preview of the full-size image.
acceptanceCriteria: The Photo column cell at the specified XPath does not load/render any images until the user clicks the filename.
The Photo column cell displays a filename (text) corresponding to the stored photo path (e.g., last path segment after `/`).
Clicking the filename opens a modal/overlay containing the full-size image loaded from the existing photo path resolution logic.
Closing the modal/overlay (via close button and/or clicking the backdrop) returns the user to the table with no row/table state changes.
No other `<td>` elements, columns, row layout, sorting/filtering controls, or table behavior are changed.

file_operations.description: Update only the Photo column body `` renderer (the cell matching XPath td[4]) to remove any inline ``/image element and instead render the derived filename as a clickable button/link. Wire click handling to open a modal without touching other columns or table behaviors. Ensure filename is derived from the existing stored `photoPath` (last path segment).

Create a small, reusable modal/overlay component that displays a full-size image when given a `photoPath`, including close button and backdrop click-to-close. Use the blob-storage component capability (e.g., `useFileUrl`) inside this modal to resolve `photoPath` to a displayable URL. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new PhotoPreviewModal into AdminDirectory state: store the currently selected `photoPath` when a filename is clicked, render the modal only when selected, and pass an onClose handler that clears selection. Ensure this wiring introduces no layout/styling changes beyond the Photo column cell content change.

requirements.summary: Ensure Photo modal image loading is on-demand and does not trigger directory refetches or mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: On initial render of the Administrative Directory Table, the browser network log shows no image requests originating from the Photo column cells.
Clicking a filename triggers exactly one image load for that clicked item (no preloading of other rows’ images).
Opening/closing the modal does not trigger directory data refetching or change any non-Photo UI state (expanded rows, filters, search, pagination if present).

file_operations.description: Implement on-demand image resolution/loading so the blob-storage URL resolution and resulting `` render occur only when the modal is open and a single `photoPath` is selected; avoid any preloading behavior. Use blob-storage hook configuration patterns (e.g., conditional/enabled fetching) as applicable. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the Photo column cell does not invoke any image URL resolution logic during table render (no per-row `useFileUrl` calls for Photo cells). Confirm modal open/close is purely local UI state (no `refetchDirectory()` calls, no directory mutations) and does not alter other AdminDirectory state such as expanded rows, search/filter values, or view mode.
